dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: You look so excited lately. What is going on?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I am thinking of changing careers. I want to leave accounting and become a designer.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Wow, that is quite a change! What made you decide?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I realized that I no longer feel motivated, and I want my work to be creative.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Are you going to quit your job straight away?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, that would be a big risk. I will study in the evenings first.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: What skills do you need to learn?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Mainly design software and communication, but I already have good organizational skills.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: That is an advantage. Do you know anyone in that field?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, a former classmate is my mentor now, and she gives me honest feedback.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Not too much. I found an online course that costs less than a monthly gym membership.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: And what does your family think about it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: They are worried, but they support me, as long as I have a plan.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: I admire your courage. Many people never take the first step.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. Even if it fails, I will have learned something new.
